[EN] Little Mysterium pup thinks he's a big shot.

I've seen him asking others to "fetch this," "kill that." Next thing you know he'll be asking someone to bring him the Everbloom itself.

Maybe someday he'll grow big and strong enough to dirty his own hands.

You don't see me pushing my work off on travelers!
[ES] El cachorro del Mysterium se cree gran cosa.

Lo he visto pidiendo a otros que "consigan esto", "maten aquello". Lo siguiente será que le pida a alguien que le traiga la mismísima Everbloom.

Tal vez algún día crezca lo suficiente y sea fuerte como para ensuciarse las manos.

¡A mí no me ves endosándole mi trabajo a los viajeros!
